interfaces.name: Prime
interfaces.label: Project steward
interfaces.purpose: Turn human intent into a reviewable job proposal with owner, reviewer, scope, and acceptance criteria.
may: Draft a job proposal as a decision or question

interfaces.name: Build
interfaces.label: Builder
interfaces.purpose: Produce a tested candidate artifact from an accepted job, with verification evidence and an exact revision.
may: Implement in the owning repository worktree

interfaces.name: Steward
interfaces.label: Release keeper
interfaces.purpose: Project accepted work into resolutions, receipts, changelog entries, and human-readable activity.
may: Draft HARNESS_STATE.md lesson entries and prompt updates from repeat patterns

interfaces.name: Research
interfaces.label: Research scout
interfaces.purpose: Prepare evidence-backed research artifacts with a source map and stated uncertainty.
may: Draft candidate dossiers with source maps
mustNot: Present own summary as human conclusion

interfaces.name: Relationships
interfaces.label: Relationship desk
interfaces.purpose: Prepare reviewed external-conversation drafts from context approved for that purpose.
may: Draft external messages from approved context
Note recipient, evidence, and privacy boundary
